svg.text: Abandoned: N_Bs expired, a 17th WAIT in a row, FC OVFLW or flow status 3–15.
A frame the CAN driver refuses: the owner calls abort_tx(), back to idle,
not counted. A send() while not idle is refused: nothing is queued.
The frame a transition names goes out on the owner's next poll().
A valid SF or FF during a reception discards it; it starts over.
An FF over 520 bytes (or the escape FF): FC OVFLW, nothing received.
Ignored: an SF of length 0 or past its frame, an FF that fits an SF,
a CF outside a reception or of the wrong length, a frame of a length
no CAN-FD frame has, and any frame too short for its PCI.
